purpose: Supplemental primary sources for 578 nm clock Rabi-power, linewidth and motional-convention review; no canonical data changed.
historicalProvenanceBoundary: Numerical support for an adopted value is distinct from finding the actual historical source or generating artifact of an internal record.

sources.title: Marco Pizzocaro et al.
sources.detail: Absolute frequency measurement of the 1S0-3P0 transition of 171Yb
sources.referenceRole: 578 nm clock interrogation power, stated waist and nominal pi-pulse operating point; not a complete absolute Rabi calibration
evidenceNotes: The same operating paragraph explicitly states 70 nW incident power, a 200 um 1/e^2 intensity waist radius and a 60 ms nominal pi pulse. The radius convention is established; absolute beam calibration and matched time-domain Rabi data remain incomplete.
These experimental operating parameters are not a separately fitted Rabi frequency and do not determine the historical source of the internal T3 matrix element.
sources.numericalValidation: source-support-only; not a complete independent Rabi calibration

sources.title: C.-Y. Xu et al.
sources.detail: Measurement of the Hyperfine Quenching Rate of the Clock Transition in 171Yb
sources.referenceRole: Independent source for the free-atom hyperfine-quenching rate and a derived effective F-reduced clock dipole
evidenceNotes: The reported free-171Yb rate is (4.42 +/- 0.35)e-2 s^-1, inferred from fluorescence in solid Ne with medium corrections; it is not an uncorrected trap-survival lifetime.
Numerical support for a clock dipole does not establish that this paper was the source of the old internal 5.30e-5 or 9.19e-5 records.
The local PDF identifier states arXiv:1406.2340v1 (9 June 2014), while its embedded draft date is 6 October 2018; retain the identifier, hash and 2014 journal identity separately.
sources.numericalValidation: source-support-only; not a complete independent Rabi calibration

sources.title: J. L. Siegel et al.
sources.detail: Excited-Band Coherent Delocalization for Improved Optical Lattice Clock Performance
sources.referenceRole: 171Yb 3P0 natural-lifetime determination and separation of trap-light-induced quenching
evidenceNotes: The reported natural lifetime is 19(2) s; the separately reported trap-light quenching rate is 5.7(7)e-4 Er^-1 s^-1.
A natural-lifetime inference and trap-light quenching must not be replaced by one unspecified in-trap survival time or treated as a matched power-waist-Rabi measurement.
sources.numericalValidation: source-support-only; not a complete independent Rabi calibration

sources.title: S. Blatt et al.
sources.detail: Rabi Spectroscopy and Excitation Inhomogeneity in a 1D Optical Lattice Clock
sources.referenceRole: Method source for motional-state-dependent carrier Rabi coupling and excitation inhomogeneity
evidenceNotes: The experimental species is 87Sr; the mathematical treatment can inform a conditional 171Yb analysis, but the Sr numerical trap and temperature values are not 171Yb data.
Motional averaging can differ from the bare beam-centre dipole coupling; this source alone does not prove the cause or size of the Pizzocaro operating-point discrepancy.
sources.numericalValidation: source-support-only; not a complete independent Rabi calibration
